title: heterotheca scabrifolia
intro: Heterotheca scabrifolia, commonly known as rough greenthread, is a flowering plant that belongs to the sunflower family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating fever and digestive issues. The plant is valued for its ability to reduce inflammation and its antiseptic properties, making it a popular choice for treating wounds and infections. Heterotheca scabrifolia contains bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
